theorem: Heat traces multiply under Kronecker-sum refinements, so spectral dimensions add exactly. Each two-child fiber contributes 4 mu t/(e^{2 mu t}+1). Repeated refinement can raise or stage an intermediate spectral-dimension profile, but the profile depends on the arbitrary fiber rates. The simultaneous scale orbit mu_j->c mu_j, t->t/c proves that these flows contain no intrinsic seconds or lengths.
